column1: # Measure gates for ltra3_2_line (execution-manifest contract: !measures).
# Why measures: TRAN 0.2N 47.9NS with no tmax lets both simulators step
# the LTRA ringing at ~1 ns, and neither resolves the v(751) overshoot
# there: the reference reads 5.351 V, RSpice 5.021 V, and each converges
# to the same 5.5077 V (ngspice) / 5.5077 V (RSpice) at 0.02 ns. The
# pointwise gate trips on two v(651) tail samples 6 mV apart on a 5 V
# node. Refining ngspice's own step moves its crossings by up to 54 ps
# and its settled means by up to 6.5 mV; RSpice's crossings sit within
# 91 ps and its means within 1.5 mV.
# Source: VS1/VS2 PULSE 0->5 V at 15.9 ns, 5->0 V at 31.9 ns. v(648),
# v(651) = driven ends, v(751) = far end. Crossing and mean tolerances
# are twice the larger of the reference's refinement movement and
# RSpice's deviation; the overshoot gate is 10 percent because the
# coarse-grid reference itself is 3 percent short of its converged
# value.
